item.title: Blaze of Destiny III -The Tears of the Blue Sea-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Talisman
  • 発売日: 2005-12-16
  • スコア: 6.720000000000001/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Blaze of Destiny III -The Tears of the Blue Sea-
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Alfred is a soldier from the empire of Kias. While on a naval transport they encountered a massive storm and our hero was taken by the sea. Strangely, he saw a vision of a mysterious woman before passing out. When he awoke he found himself on an island where monsters roam freely. There he witnesses the one in his vision being taken by a pack of monsters and he quickly decides to save her and everyone else on this island.

  • 日本語名: 戦火－IKUSABI－
  • 英語名: Ikusabi

あらすじ

There is secret demon-hunting organization that dates back to ancient times. Its members - though few in numbers - protect peace of each epoch from the shadows. It’s year 1707 now. Peace has come to this land with the establishment of Tokugawa Shogunate. However, suddenly a dangerous shadow monster again threatens the world. His name is Oda Nobunaga.
